runSpeed.label: Run speed
runSpeed.help: Top speed on the ground, metres per second.

groundAccel.label: Ground grip
groundAccel.help: How fast you reach full speed or stop. Low = slippery.

airControl.label: Air control
airControl.help: Share of ground grip you keep in the air.

jumpSpeed.label: Jump speed
jumpSpeed.help: Upward speed at take-off. Height = speed squared / (2 x gravity).

gravity.label: Gravity
gravity.help: Pull while rising, metres per second squared.

fallGravity.label: Fall gravity x
fallGravity.help: Extra pull while falling. Above 1 makes jumps snappy instead of floaty.

jumpCut.label: Short-hop cut
jumpCut.help: Letting go of jump early keeps this share of upward speed. 1 = no variable height.

coyoteTime.label: Coyote time (s)
coyoteTime.help: You can still jump this long after walking off a ledge.

jumpBuffer.label: Jump buffer (s)
jumpBuffer.help: A jump pressed this long before landing still happens.

turnSpeed.label: Turn speed
turnSpeed.help: How fast the character faces where it moves.

follow.label: Follow speed
follow.help: Higher = camera sticks closer to the player.

rest.label: Rest at ends (s)
rest.help: Pause and wobble before rolling back: the warning.

invincible.label: Invincible
invincible.help: Stones and falls don't cost hearts.
